The Terms

Sign for worse conditions and Meridian pays better. Every one of these is a real handicap, it applies the moment you deploy, and the bonus is paid only if you walk out. Die under your own terms and you have simply made a bad day worse.

Party

Up to four pillagers, linked by invite code. The others in your party walk the Undercroft floor with you, with their names over their heads, and when the host takes the party up, everyone ascends into the same raid.
TRADING. Up top: open the backpack, pick the item and press Z (Y on a controller) to drop it at your feet; your teammate searches the pile like any box. In the Undercroft: right-click a stash item (Y on a controller) and choose Drop on the floor; your teammate walks to the crate and presses E (A on a controller).

Dev tools

Instrumentation, not gameplay. This is where the export, the bot sim, the roadmap and the old builds live. HIS NOTE: "way too much sthit going on in the stash, needs to simplify" - the Operator Terminal was carrying all of this on the same screen as his stash and his loadout, so the panel he opens twenty times a raid to look at loot was two thirds developer furniture.

THE MAINFRAME

Work you have signed for. Contracts pay on top of your haul, and they do not expire while you are down here.
Kills, loot, doors, selling and extracting all pay XP. Dying pays half. A hundred rewards, claimed in order, and nothing here ever resets.
What I am building next. In order, and it is the actual queue rather than a wish list.
The mainframe pays per extraction, every extraction, for as long as it is running.

WELCOME PACK

A few things to play with before your first climb, straight into your stash: a green gun and a blue one, heals, plates and grenades. Nothing here is bought. It is yours for turning up. Take it, or close this and go without; it is offered once.

SEND YOUR RUN REPORTS?

Every raid ends with a run report: what happened in the raid, what you carried, any note you type, and an anonymous install id. Nothing else about you. Say YES and each report is sent to the developer as the raid ends, so the game gets better from what happened to you. Close this and it stays in your Downloads folder instead, where you can send it yourself. You can change your mind any time in Settings.

SETTINGS

THE RAID rows below change how the game plays, and every option named Standard is how it plays out of the box. Everything under them is presentation and changes nothing.
